_comment: Target filter uses ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN over the current attack's subtypes+types, same spelling as ironsong_response_blue; MODIFY_ATTACK hits the current attack the reaction targets. Known representation gap on clause 2: 'If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links' is evaluated when the reaction RESOLVES, but the engine appends a ChainLink only at the damage step (engine.py ~2137-2150), so the CURRENT attack is never in state.chain_links at that moment. If the targeted dagger attack is itself Draconic, the printed rules count it and this condition does not - a deck relying on dagger+one prior Draconic link will see no Fealty where the table would. Everything else is exact: CHAIN_LINKS_CONTROLLED_GTE reads amount + attribute (talents/classes/subtypes/keywords per stored link). Fealty token definition already exists (json/cin/fealty.json); CREATE_TOKEN spelling copied from pledge_fealty_red.
